#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Extract all github.com/OWNER owners from src/hackingtool (only .py and .yaml files)
# This mimics what the fixed gen_catalog_owners.py does

skip="org orgs search repos"

find src/hackingtool \( -name '*.py' -o -name '*.yaml' \) -type f | sort | while read -r f; do
  # Skip the output file itself
  case "$(basename "$f")" in catalog_owners.py) continue ;; esac
  
  grep -oP 'github\.com/\K[A-Za-z0-9._-]+' "$f" | while read -r owner; do
    # Normalize: strip version suffixes like /v2, /v3 from go import paths
    # The regex captures the first path segment after github.com/
    echo "$owner"
  done
done | sort -u
